# SVAULT

> SVAULT is an encrypted credential vault created by Badje. It encrypts credential records locally in the browser and uses the Stellar network for signed, traceable ledger operations.

## Primary pages
- Product overview: https://svault.ir/
- Web application: https://app.svault.ir/
- Privacy Policy: https://svault.ir/privacy.html
- Terms of Use: https://svault.ir/terms.html
- Creator: https://badje.ir/

## Key facts
- SVAULT is a Badje product; it is not a product of the Stellar Development Foundation.
- SVAULT uses Stellar accounts, signed transactions, fees and ledgers.
- The application supports Testnet, Public and configured Custom Stellar networks.
- Record content is encrypted locally with AES-256-GCM before ledger preparation.
- The database secret is used in the active browser session and is not intended to be stored as application data.
- A dedicated approval screen shows estimated fees and ledger changes before signing and submission.
- Public Stellar transactions and metadata may be visible and effectively permanent.
- Users must protect their database secret, device, browser environment, backups and signing keys.

## Language availability
- The public presentation website is currently available in English only.
